name: hw-underline
title: Squiggle Marks
description: A hand-drawn mark that draws on and boils under, through or beside one phrase: squiggle underline, double strike or bracket, sized to the measured phrase. Ships the hw-boil and hw-mark helpers for hosts that annotate their own text.

variables.label: Mark
variables.description: underline: a squiggle under the phrase; strike: a double pass through it; bracket: a bracket at its left.
